name: NeX-MPI
aliases: NeX MPI with Neural Basis Expansion
definition: A modified Multiplane Image (MPI) that models view-dependent effects (reflection, refraction) by parameterizing pixel color as a function of viewing direction using learnable basis functions, solving the issue of non-Lambertian surfaces appearing dull or breaking down in standard MPIs.
summary: NeX-MPI is a real-time view synthesis method that combines Multiplane Image parameterization with neural basis expansion to model view-dependent effects on non-Lambertian surfaces.
